say:5:1622442002:1.text: I can't wait to see them again next spring.
say:5:1622442002:1.source_cn: 嗯！真期待明年春天和它们再次相见！

say:6:1622442004:1.text: Cassadee doesn't look away until the last bird melts into the sky.
say:6:1622442004:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂久久凝望天空，直到最后一只候鸟也消失在云层中。

say:8:1622442005:1.text: Professor Hepler... The north wind—you didn't just mean the spell, did you?
say:8:1622442005:1.source_cn: 赫普老师，您说的北风……指的不仅是那股魔法风暴，对吗？

say:9:1622442006:1.text: The north wind gives them the push at the moment that matters, but it doesn't fly for them.
say:9:1622442006:1.source_cn: 北风是在关键时刻推他们一把的力量，但不是替他们飞行。

say:10:1622442007:1.text: I thought help meant feeding, patching wounds, preventing every loss... Turned out that it almost smothered their nature.
say:10:1622442007:1.source_cn: 我之前一直在喂食、治疗，想让他们不受任何伤害……这就像...

say:11:1622442008:1.text: Being a north wind at the moment they prepare to fly is actually the best help one can give.
say:11:1622442008:1.source_cn: 但……真正的帮助，应该是在他们准备好起飞时，给予那临门...

say:12:1622442009:1.text: When you're in the court, in that tangle of politics, I hope you remember this, Cassadee.
say:12:1622442009:1.source_cn: 当你去了宫廷，面对那些出身高贵的同僚和复杂的局势时，科...

say:13:1622442010:1.text: Cassadee answers before Hepler can finish, calm and certain.
say:13:1622442010:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂接上了赫普的话，语气坚定。

say:14:1622442011:1.text: I don't need an umbrella over my head, but a steady north wind at my back when it matters.
say:14:1622442011:1.source_cn: 我需要的不是大家时刻在身边为我遮风挡雨，而是像今天这股...

say:15:1622442012:1.text: We gave them the north wind, but it would've been wasted if they didn't choose the sky.
say:15:1622442012:1.source_cn: 就像候鸟一样，尽管梅林大人和赫普老师为它们提供了北风，...
say:15:1622442012:1.male: We gave them the north wind, but it would've been wasted if they didn't choose the sky.
say:15:1622442012:1.female: We gave them the north wind, but it would've been wasted if they didn't choose the sky.

say:17:1622442013:1.text: Cassadee looks out at the clear sky. The flock is gone. In its place, the dusk creates a golden route that stretches all the way into the horizon.
say:17:1622442013:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂看向远方天空，那里已经空无一鸟，但晚霞正在铺开一...

say:19:1622442014:1.text: Cassadee, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I won't be the lead bird that charts your route. But there will always be a north wind lifting you.
say:19:1622442014:1.male: Cassadee, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I won't be the lead bird that charts your route. But there will always be a north wind lifting you.
say:19:1622442014:1.female: Cassadee, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I won't be the lead bird that charts your route. But there will always be a north wind lifting you.

say:20:1622442015:1.text: As long as you are ready to soar.
say:20:1622442015:1.source_cn: 只要你已鼓足冲向云霄的勇气。

say:24:1622442003:1.text: They'll survive the freeze, the wind, all of it and reach their southern home.
say:24:1622442003:1.source_cn: 嗯！它们一定能穿越风暴与严寒，顺利抵达温暖的南方家园！

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 希望它们能顺利到达南方
